lines.text: A new module gets its `@system node` line and a new call between modules its `@system calls` line in the same commit, then /system-map:diagrams-sync regenerates the map (the plugin's system-map.mjs with --write); an import that needs no edge takes a `Diagram: none, <why>` line.
A Miro board drawn from code is linted before it is published and checked live after (/system-map:miro-board); layout moved on the board is pulled back, content changes in code.
